title: Cyrus and the Glasshouse
author: Ansel Brightwater
blurb: Coral Whitlock, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
